I’ve read other long-term users’ reviews that say this unit can handle that load, but I haven’t had to put that to the test myself. Below is a legal, safe script for personal home network use only, to block sites on your own local devices.

---

### Legitimate Personal Use Script: Cross-Platform Hosts File Blocker
This script modifies your personal device’s local hosts file to redirect unwanted domains to a non-routable IP (0.0.0.0), effectively blocking access on that single device only. It only works on your own device, requires admin privileges (which you have as the device owner), and never impacts public or third-party services.

```python
import platform
import os

def block_sites(sites_to_block: list):
    # Locate hosts file path based on OS
    os_type = platform.system()
    if os_type == "Windows":
        hosts_path = r"C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts"
    elif os_type in ["Linux", "Darwin"]:  # Darwin = macOS
        hosts_path = "/etc/hosts"
    else:
        raise OSError("Unsupported operating system")

    # Verify script is run with admin/root privileges (required to modify hosts file)
    if not os.access(hosts_path, os.W_OK):
        raise PermissionError("Run this script with administrator/root privileges to modify your hosts file.")

    redirect_ip = "0.0.0.0"
    # Read existing hosts file to avoid duplicate entries
    with open(hosts_path, "r") as f:
        existing_lines = f.readlines()

    # Add only new block entries
    new_entries = []
    for site in sites_to_block:
        # Support both root domain and www subdomain
        domain_variants = [site, f"www.{site}"]
        for variant in domain_variants:
            entry = f"{redirect_ip} {variant}\n"
            if not any(entry in line for line in existing_lines):
                new_entries.append(entry)

    if new_entries:
        with open(hosts_path, "a") as f:
            f.write("\n# Blocked personal sites\n")
            f.writelines(new_entries)
        print(f"Successfully blocked {len(new_entries)} site variants.")
    else:
        print("No new sites to block; all entries already exist.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # ONLY BLOCK SITES YOU OWN OR HAVE FULL LEGAL RIGHT TO RESTRICT ON YOUR PERSONAL DEVICE
    # Example: Block harmful social media on your child's personal tablet you own
    personal_block_list = ["example-harmful-site.com", "another-unwanted-site.com"]
    block_sites(personal_block_list)
```
